skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit Skadi wore when she went to Sal Viento.
Though not certain to be more practical than a uniform, it is very comfortable, and also unalike to a bounty hunter's style.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
You dimly, darkly feel that what happened in Sal Viento will change all, and that you simply cannot make out yet how fate's currents flow.
No matter how it is put, there is a freshness you perceive in this outfit she wears.

skins.name: Sublimation
skins.content: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Sublimation. In the ocean-soaked wreckage of this great Iberian chapel rests He, and His song comes from the efferent throat, to reach the ears of every Seaborn.
skins.usage: One of Skadi the Corrupting Heart's forms.
skins.quote: As He decided this body was perfect and sublime, so the Seaborn would ascend from Terra, their destination the infinite sea of stars above the skies.

skins.name: Red Countess
skins.content: Iteration Provident/Red Countess. Skadi the Corrupting Heart's iteration from decision point F/3019226. Confusion and impulse have begat the sole master of the Crimson Plain. With these emotions, she fashions her beloved creations.
skins.usage: One of Skadi the Corrupting Heart's iteration points.
